profiles.name: Profiles and app lock
profiles.description: Separate collections for different people or purposes, and a PIN or password that locks the window.

profiles.heading: Profiles
profiles.intro: Come here to open a separate collection on the same computer (e.g. for a sibling) or to lock the app with a PIN.
profiles.unavailable: Profiles are only available in the desktop app.
profiles.switching: Opening the profile — the app restarts…
profiles.confirm_delete: Delete profile “{name}” and all its cards? This cannot be undone.
profiles.what: Each profile is a separate collection: its own decks, cards, media, settings and AI keys; profiles can't see each other's cards. Opening another profile restarts the app with that profile.

lock.heading: App lock
lock.intro: When on, the app asks for a PIN or password at start and after a while unused. Cards are not encrypted: this only stops someone at your computer from opening the window.
lock.off: No lock is set for this profile.
lock.storage_secure: Only a salted Argon2id hash is kept, in the system keychain.
lock.storage_file: Only a salted Argon2id hash is kept, in the profile list file (the system keychain does not keep it across restarts here).
lock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
lock.scope_note: The lock keeps out casual access to this window only: the collection is not encrypted, and the command line and the MCP server are not locked.
lock.recovery_body: This profile is locked, but its PIN/password hash is gone (for example, the system keychain entry was removed). Flashcard stays locked instead of opening without a check. You can remove the lock and then set a new one.
lock.recovery_confirm: I understand: remove this profile's lock
lock.held_body: These flashcard:// links arrived while the app was locked. They run after you unlock, unless you drop them.
lock.idle_hint: If you don't touch the app for this long, the window locks. Unlock it and you carry on where you left off.
lock.current_hint: Needed to change or remove the lock.
lock.kind_hint: A PIN is 4–12 digits; a password 6–128 characters.
lock.clear_desc: The window opens without a PIN or password again. Enter the current one to confirm.
lock.new_hint: Enter it and press “Set lock”; from then on it is asked at start.
lock.new_hint_change: To change it, type the current one above and the new one here.
lock.forgot: What if I forget my PIN?
lock.forgot_desc: There is no “forgot my PIN” reset inside the app. Your cards are not deleted and not encrypted; from the lock screen you can still open another profile.
lock.forgot_keychain: To remove this profile's lock, delete the “{account}” entry under “app.flashcard” in your system keychain (Credential Manager on Windows). On its next start Flashcard says “The lock's data is missing” and offers to remove the lock; then you can set a new PIN.
lock.forgot_file: On this computer the lock's hash is kept in the profile list file (profiles.json). To remove the lock, delete the “hash” field of this profile's lock in that file; on its next start Flashcard says “The lock's data is missing” and offers to remove the lock ({account}).
lock.advanced_summary: How the PIN is stored and what the lock does not protect.
lock.scope_label: What the lock does not protect
lock.attempts_note: The first 5 wrong tries are free; then you wait 1 s, 2 s, 4 s… up to 5 min. The count is kept on disk, so restarting the app gives no fresh tries.

example.idle: {count} min → if you don't touch the app for {count} minutes, the lock screen comes up.
example.idle_never: Never → it only locks at start and when you press “Lock now”.

validation.lock_secret: A PIN needs 4–12 digits; a password 6–128 characters.
validation.lock_idle: Choose one of the offered times.
